DecisionsDescription: One row per problem, numbered. The Plan column lists the steps done if you select the row; the step marked ✦ is the only one that calls an agent. Nothing is pushed to a repository yet. Click a header to sort.
NothingToDecide: Ahoy! Nothing needs a decision: the fleet is in good shape.
NoSourceConfigured: No source of findings is configured. Connect a Portarr, or point Orchestrarr at a sample file.
ShowingLastRead: Showing what was read at {time}. The last read failed: {error}
StepMergePullRequests: Merge the pull requests that pass
ErrorFailed: The source could not be read
ErrorUnauthorized: The source refused the credentials, or asks to sign in
ErrorTimeout: The source did not answer in time
ErrorInvalidResponse: The source answered with something unexpected
ForgeNotConnected: Not connected: pull requests are not read
ErrorRateLimited: The source asks to be read less often: its limit is reached
QueueDescription: The decisions you approved. Each one makes a batch of tasks that the Runner checks and runs.
QueueEmpty: Nothing is waiting: approve a decision card and it appears here.
ActivityDescription: The audit trail: who decided what, what was refused and why, and the global stop. Newest first.
EventInstanceCreated: Database created: the global stop starts engaged
SignInFailed: Signing in failed. Try again; if it keeps failing, ask whoever runs this server.
StorageSqlite: Saved in a file: kept across restarts
StorageMemory: In memory: lost at every restart
KillSwitchEngaged: The global stop is engaged: nothing is approved and nothing launches.
KillSwitchFailed: The global stop could not be changed.
ApprovalErrorUnknownWorkItem: This decision is no longer there: refresh the list.
ApprovalErrorPullRequestsNotRead: The pull requests are not read yet, or only an old read is left: try again in a moment.
ApprovalErrorStepNotOffered: A ticked step is not possible here.
ApprovalErrorStepNotGranted: A ticked step is not granted to Orchestrarr.
ApprovalErrorStepNotSupported: A ticked step does not run yet.
ApprovalErrorMergeNeedsValidation: Merging needs the change to be built and tested first.
ApprovalErrorNoPullRequests: There is no pull request to approve.
ApprovalErrorAlreadyApproved: These pull requests were already approved at this commit.
ApprovalErrorTooManyRequests: Too many attempts: wait a minute and try again.
ApprovalErrorAuditUnavailable: The audit trail cannot be written or read, so the request is refused.
ApprovalErrorPlanChanged: The pull requests changed since you looked at them: read the card again, then approve.
KillSwitchOperatorsOnly: Only an operator can use the global stop.
KillSwitchCannotBeReleased: The global stop could not be released: its state cannot be saved, so it stays engaged.
KillSwitchCannotBeTraced: The global stop could not be released: the release cannot be written to the audit trail, so it stays engaged.
KillSwitchNotSaved: The global stop is engaged, but its state could not be saved or read: do not count on it across a restart.
ApprovalErrorTooManyRepairs: Too many repairs for one approval: each is an agent run that spends the subscription. Select fewer (five at most) and approve again.
ApprovalErrorTooManyPullRequests: This card holds too many pull requests for one batch: approve it after some are merged or closed.
ApprovalErrorSecondFactorRequired: Type the 6-digit code of your authenticator app.
RunsDescription: What the Runner did with each approval: every check, every task, and the chained trace of what happened.
RunsEmpty: No run yet. Approve a decision and the Runner will pick it up.
RunNoRunner: No Runner has taken it yet.
RunTraceChained: Each line carries the hash of the one before, the first the digest of the batch: a line changed or removed afterwards breaks the chain.
RefusalReplayed: this batch was already seen by the Runner
RefusalSecondFactor: the code of the second factor was not accepted
RefusalKindNotAllowed: the Runner does not accept this kind of task
RefusalRepositoryNotAllowed: the Runner does not accept this repository
RefusalJournalMismatch: the batch is not the one that was approved (the journal does not hold it)
RefusalMalformed: the batch is not well formed
RunnerNone: No Runner has asked for work yet. Nothing runs until one does.
SecondFactorRequired: A code from your authenticator app, checked by the Runner
QueueNoRunner: No Runner is connected: approvals wait until one asks for work.
SignInLocked: Too many failed attempts. Try again in a few minutes.
CannotReachServer: Orchestrarr cannot be reached. Reload the page in a moment.
IdentifierHint: This identifier is what your authenticator app is enrolled under: give it to the enrolment command of the Runner.
PasswordChanged: Password changed. Your other sessions were ended.
PasswordRefused: This password is refused: it must be at least 12 characters and not the name of the account.
PasswordNotChanged: The password could not be changed.
AccountsDescription: Who can sign in, with which role. A change applies at once, and a disabled account loses its sessions.
AccountsNotAllowed: Accounts cannot be read: only an administrator manages them.
DeleteAccountConfirm: Delete the account {name}? Its sessions end at once.
AccountConflict: That name is taken, or the change would leave no administrator.
AccountInvalid: Refused: a name is 2 to 64 letters, digits, dots, dashes or underscores; a password is at least 12 characters.
EventLoginFailed: Sign-in refused: wrong name or password.
EventLoginLocked: Sign-in refused: the name is locked after too many failures.
EventPasswordLocked: Password check refused: too many failures.
EventAccountReset: Account reset with the break-glass password.
OptionsDescription: Switches for development and tests. Everyone reads them; an administrator changes them. What lowers security needs the host to allow it and your password.
OptionSecondFactorDescription: Approving a decision asks for the one-time code of your authenticator app, and the Runner checks it. Turn it off only while developing or testing: with it off, a signed-in operator approves without the second proof.
OptionLockedHost: This host does not allow lowering security from the screen. It is started that way in production, and nothing here can change it.
OptionLockedConfiguration: The configuration of the host fixes this option: the screen cannot change it.
OptionTurnOffWarning: Without the code, anyone who is signed in as an operator can approve a decision with no second proof. The Runner must be set not to ask for it either. The change is written in the activity trail.
NotificationSecondFactorOffText: Approvals carry no second proof. This is for development and tests only.
NotificationStopText: Nothing is handed to the Runners until the stop is released.
NotificationSourceTitle: The source of findings cannot be read
NotificationSourceText: What is on screen may be out of date. See the Status screen.
NotificationNoRunnerText: An approval waits until a Runner asks for work.
LiveOnHint: What is on screen follows what happens: the host tells this page as soon as something changes.
LiveOffHint: The live channel is not open: this page reads again every thirty seconds.
SelectAllShown: Select every problem shown that can be done
StopBeforeProductionHint: Stop before production: the pull request is merged into develop and waits for you there
ProblemScanUnavailable: The dependency scan is off or unreadable for this repository (Dependabot may be off): its vulnerable dependencies are not watched
StepChipValidate: Validate in the Orchestrarr Runner (build, tests)
StepChipRepair: Repair if it fails (patch shown, nothing pushed)
WhyNone: Nothing stops it: the description allows the whole chain.
WhyNoActionDefined: No action is described for this kind of problem.
WhyPullRequestsNotCurrent: The pull requests are not read, or only an old read is left.
WhyNotGranted: Orchestrarr is not granted this step on this application.
WhyNoRunner: No connected Runner accepts this step on this repository.
WhyQualificationNotDescribed: The description does not say how to know it works: it is validated but never merged.
WhyChecksFailing: The CI of this pull request fails.
WhyChecksNotPassing: The checks have not passed yet.
WhyCannotBeMergedNow: The pull request cannot be merged as it stands (conflict, behind or blocked).
WhyNoRollbackDescribed: The description does not say how to roll back: it stops before production.
WhyNoCheckAfterDeployDescribed: The description has no check after the deployment: it stops before production.
WhyUpdateClassStopsBeforeProduction: This class of update stops before production by default.
WhyQualificationFailed: The Orchestrarr Runner ran this commit and it fails.
WhyRepairFailed: An agent tried and did not succeed: it can try again.
WhyPatchReady: An agent repaired it and the patch is in its run. Applying it to the pull request is not built yet.
WhyPassesHereChecksFailing: It passes in the Orchestrarr Runner but the CI fails: there is nothing to repair in the code. Look at the pipeline of the repository (for example an old Node version). No AI action.
SearchProblems: Search a package or a text
SelectionNone: Select problems to validate them together.
SelectionSummary: {problems} problems in {apps} applications → {apps} batches, one code
SelectionSummaryOne: 1 problem in 1 application → 1 batch, one code
SelectionSummaryOneApp: {problems} problems in 1 application → 1 batch, one code
PlanRepair: {app}: an agent tries to repair {count} in the Orchestrarr Runner, the patch is shown and nothing is pushed
PlanQualifyOnly: {app}: build, test and qualify once, nothing merged ({count})
PlanMerge: {app}: build, test and qualify once → merge into develop → stops before production ({count})
PlanPromote: {app}: build, test and qualify once → merge into develop → production allowed, not built yet ({count})
SelectionApproved: Approved: {count} pull requests in one batch. The Runner takes it next; follow it in Runs.
SkipHint: Set this aside. It is shown again only if the problem changes. The history keeps it.
ChecksNotRun: CI not run for a bot
WhyChecksNotRun: The CI could not run for this bot's pull request (it needs secrets that the forge does not give to a bot). The Orchestrarr Runner's validation is what counts.
WhyNotLongTermSupport: This version of Node is not a long-term release (odd versions never are): it is not proposed.
WhyManagedByPlatform: This image comes with the platform (K3s): it is updated with it, not on its own.
WhyMajorNeedsPlan: A new major version: not a tag to bump but a change to read about and to plan (a database needs its data migrated).
ProblemDormant: No push for {count} days and the CI is red: archive the repository or fix it. Until then its pull requests are not listed.
ProblemFloatingImage: {image} runs under a tag that moves: nobody can tell which version it is. Pin a version.
SkipRefused: The row could not be set aside: it changed since you saw it, a run is working on it, it is a danger, or you may not decide. Read the table again.
SkipNotForDanger: A danger is not set aside: it is dealt with at its source.
CannotReadHistory: The history could not be read: {error}
WhyNotInScope: This image is written in no repository of the description: add the repository that deploys it to the description, or leave it out of the scope.
WhyManagedByAutomation: The line that writes this version is rewritten by an automation (Flux): it is not ours to change.
WhyCodeDiffersFromRunning: The code says one version and another one runs: the next deployment would change something nobody decided. Look at the code first.
WhyCodeChangeShown: The place in the code is known and the change is shown. Orchestrarr writes nothing yet: apply it yourself, or wait for the write power.
WhyPlatformUpgradeIsPlanned: A platform upgrade touches everything that runs on it, so it is described and never offered: one minor version at a time, workers first, a snapshot before, a way back.
WhyPlatformVersionNotRead: The variable that holds the version of the platform is not where the description says.
CodeWhereOf: Where the version of {problem} is written
CodeNothingWritten: Nothing is written to the repository.
CodeChangeUnavailable: The change could not be computed.
WhySeveralEnvironments: This image runs in several environments: a change is made for one at a time, qualified and then promoted, so none is proposed for all at once. The places are shown.
WhyPinnedByDigest: This reference is pinned by a digest: the pin is a decision, and a tag that a registry can move would take its place. The place is shown, no change is proposed.
WhyCodeNotFullyRead: A repository of the description could not be read: the image may be written there, so it is not said to be written nowhere.
HistoryDescription: What was decided: the rows approved, with what became of them, and the rows set aside, which can be taken back.
NotificationCodeProblemTitle: A repository of the description is not read: {repository}
NotificationCodeErrorTitle: The code of the description could not be read
NotificationCodeErrorText: {error}: what was read last is used.
